title: docs(qa): approvals checklist reads a paused run's variables; deep-link APP is com.objectstack.setup
body:
Part of #25807 (wave-2 accuracy, slice D)
Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：审批测试清单两条条目的文字校准——动态审批人路由条目改为直接读取暂停运行的变量快照（保留原有的结果校验），通知深链条目把落地应用段写正为 `com.objectstack.setup`。
- 为什么改：QA 运行 #27134 实测发现两处说法已过时：暂停的运行现在会返回变量（#7639），落地 URL 的应用段也不是 `setup`。
- 风险与回滚：仅改一份 QA 清单 JSON，不动产品代码、不发布；回滚即 revert 本提交。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` 中 `approvals.dynamic-approver-routing` 的 acceptance[3] 与 knownGaps[0]。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，预期输出 `OK — 16 areas, 329 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One file, two items, each `revision` +1 from main with main's `history` kept as an exact prefix and one appended row citing #27134.

**`approvals.dynamic-approver-routing` r4 → r5**
- `knownGaps[0]` is rewritten as CLOSED by #7639, not deleted. A paused run's detail now carries its variables: both suspend sites (the `status: 'paused'` recordLog in `service-automation/src/engine.ts`, and the re-suspend in `run-resume.ts`, which is where this flow re-pauses at stage 2) hand one snapshot to the continuation and to the paused log entry that `GET /api/v1/automation/:name/runs/:runId` serves. #27134 measured it live.
- `acceptance[3]` is stronger, not weaker. It gains a snapshot leg: on the stage-2-paused run, `variables['lead_review.next_reviewers']` must equal the submitted pick, ids and order. Decision outputs land as flat NODEID.KEY variables (`engine.ts#applyResumeSignal`). The resolution leg stays unchanged: stage-2 `pending_approvers`, 1 → 1 and 2 → 2, same order. Both legs must hold on both chains, and a missing or disagreeing snapshot is a FAIL. The old "⛔ Do NOT prescribe reading the run's variables snapshot" sentence is gone, because its premise no longer holds.
- `steps[7]` and `source[3]` say the same thing. The run id is the stage-2 request's `flow_run_id`.

**`approvals.notification-deep-link` r8 → r9**
- `steps[3]`: on the bare `/system/approvals` route, APP is `com.objectstack.setup`. `requestPagePath` (`ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`) falls back to the setup app's name `setup`. The app shell's `canonicalAppPathname` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/appRoute.ts`) then replaces that name alias with the package id `SETUP_APP_PACKAGE_ID` (`packages/apps/setup/src/index.ts`). #27134 measured this live.
- `acceptance[3]`'s verify parenthetical had the same stale `setup`, and it gets the same correction. Every clause still uses the APP placeholder, so no assertion changes.

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope, declared:** the claim named `knownGaps[0]` + acceptance[3]'s reason, and `steps[3]`. The same stale fact also sat in `steps[7]` and `source[3]` of the first item and in `acceptance[3]`'s verify of the second. They are corrected here because leaving them would make each item contradict itself. No other item is touched.
- **Not yet driven live:** the stage-2 key `lead_review.next_reviewers`. #27134 read variables on a stage-1-paused run, so the stage-2 key is grounded in source at base 74133d98. The history row says so, and a prior verdict on acceptance[3] does not carry.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → exit 0, 16 commands. All 16 were run and exited 0. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: lint/formula not built). After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` (VERDICT command-exit 0), it answered exit 0.
- `--ran` → exit 0, `16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`
